tenderSchedule.title: Providing Irrigation Facility to 40 50Nos Beneficiaries farmers through Borewell of Zunjarawad, Satti, Ramatirth, Yakkanchi, Kottalagi, Kakamari, Kannal, Kohalli & Adahalli (Adalatti) Village command area of Ammajeshwari (Kottalagi) Lift Irrigation Scheme & Hipparagi Project including borewell, pumping machinery, rising main and electrical works with all necessary accessories, successful testing and commissioning scheme including successful running and maintaining two years on Turn Key Basis
tenderSchedule.description: Providing Irrigation Facility to 40 (50Nos) Beneficiaries farmers through Borewell of Zunjarawad, Satti, Ramatirth, Yakkanchi, Kottalagi, Kakamari, Kannal, Kohalli & Adahalli (Adalatti) Village under command area of Ammajeshwari (Kottalagi) Lift Irrigation Scheme & Hipparagi Project including Geo-physical investigation of sinking borewell, drilling borewell, supplying and erection of casing pipe, PVC pipeline, pumping machineries with all accessories, supplying and erection of HT line, LT line, Transformer centre with all necessary accessories, successful testing and commissioning scheme including successful running and maintaining the unit two years on Turn Key Basis.

generalCriterionList.description: A valid copy of the KPWD Class II and Above registration with validity
Latest copy of the Income Tax return for financial year 2025-26 Assesment year 2026-27

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Valid Employees Provident Fund Registration Certificate with EPF paid challan

Scanned signature of the bidder along with phone number / authorised representative in case of a firm or company, to be attached while uploading the bid documents. Also in case of authorised representative, scanned copy of power of attorney should be uploaded & the original should be produced at the time of opening of tender
The tenderer should complete the provisions of the contract labour (Regulation and Abolition Act 1970) and the corresponding Karnataka Rules 1974)
Tender from Joint venture for Electrical work is acceptable

Work Done To qualify for award of this contract each tenderer in his or her in the last 5 years (2021-22 to 2025-26) should have satisfactorily completed (at least 90% of the contract value of on going works) as prime contractor at least one similar nature of work of value not less than For work under Rs 248.68 Lakhs (usually not less than 50% of the amount put to tender under this contract.) Work done Certificate issued by an Officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer of the concerned division (The cost of completed work of the previous year shall be updated to 2026-27 by giving weightage of 10% per year to bring it to the price level of financial year in which the tenders are invited). Certificates should be obtained from the Officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer. Note: Similar nature of work means Bidder should done the work in Geo-physical investigation of sinking bore well, drilling bore well, supplying and erection of casing pipe, PVC pipeline, pumping machineries with all accessories, supplying and erection of HT line, LT line,Transformer centre with all necessary accessories, successful testing and commissioning scheme including successful running and maintaining the unit for two years. since last 5 years (Any one year) as above mentioned years.

Each tenderer in his or her in the last 5 years (2021-22 to 2025-26) should have satisfactorily Executed in any one year the following minimum quantities of work Sinking of Borewell 40 Nos, SUBMERSIBLE PUMPSET: 6.5/7.5/10HP 40 Nos, Errection of 1 X 25 KVA Transformer Center 40 Nos

Equipments Required during Execution of works (Own & Hired) Hydraulic rig 250PSIG & above 900CFM & above with support vehicle2 Each rig should have set of GPS equipment the certificate of the same to be uploaded Own / Hired 3 Nos a. Provide relevant documents rig registered with Karnataka ground water authority Bangalore and form 7A issued by the competent authority to be uploaded, b. In case of rigs taken on lease. Lease agreement has to be executed on Rs.200.00 stamp paper with owners rigs. Lease agreement shall have validity for a period of two years from the date of Notification of tender. c. Notarized copies of valid rigs documents such as RC book. Fitness certificate up to date tax paid receipt should be uploaded

The intending bidder should have joint venture agreement on Rs.200.00 bond paper for a period of Two years with Class-I Electrical (CEIG) contractor, for executing electrical works. The copies of the J.V. bond, GST, PAN, Work done certificates of the electrical contractor should be notarized by notary and uploaded along with the tender

The intending bidder should have achieved a minimum financial turnover of not less than Amount put to tender i.e. Rs 994.71 Lakhs in at least two financial years during the last 5 years reckoned back from 2026-27 (turnover during 2021-22 to 2025-26 only will be considered) duly updating the financial turnover at 10% per year to bring it to the price level of financial year in which the tenders are invited per annum upto 2025-26. Audited profit and loss statement (with year wise turnover statement) certified by a practicing Chartered Accountant with Compulsory UID number along with copy of Income Tax returns filed for the two years indicated above shall be furnished.. (If UID Number not mentioned treated as incomplete and rejected)

Liquid Assets and or availability of credit facilities of not less than For work under Rs 165.78 Lakhs (Credit lines/ letters of credit / certificate from banks) for meeting the fund requirements etc., (usually the equivalent of the estimated cash flow for 3 months in peak construction period)

Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under: Assessed available tender capacity ( AxNx1.5- B) where A Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years (2021-22 to 2025-26) (updated to 2026-27 price level) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited.B Value, at 2025-26 price level, of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 0.75 years (period of completion of the works for which Tenders are invited) Note: The statements showing the value of existing commitments and on-going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed should be countersigned by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent
